Dear Naoya and All,
The latest proposal 4.1-2e with online revisions may still have the risk of missing intra-band cases or mixtures of inter-band and intra-band cases.
We would also like to point out that with the current proposal using “frequency separated”, we have:
*   no definition of whether 2 DLs in the same band are frequency separated or not frequency separated
  *   no definition of whether 2 ULs in the same band are frequency separated or not frequency separated
  *   The case where DL and UL are in the same TDD band but with non-overlapped bandwidth is “not frequency separated”
I just want to remind my earlier proposal, which I think identifies the flexibility that we are looking for in a simpler way:
Flexible utilization of spectrum resources for DL and UL for connected mode over different carriers/bands supports the following:
*   M DL CC and N UL CC configured for a UE, where M>=1, N>=1, and M could be larger, smaller or equal to N.
     *   For an UL CC of the N UL CCs, the DL in the same FDD/TDD band may or may not be included in the M DL CCs.
     *   For a DL CC of the M DL CCs, the UL in the same FDD/TDD band may or may not be included in the N UL CCs.
     *   Note: FDD/TDD band above is according to 5G NR band definition
Then when we start discussing what new impact we need on top of NR CA, we may just need to focus our study on case 1 and case 2:
*   Case 1: 1 DL carrier and 1 UL carrier, where the DL and UL carrier are frequency separated, and no other DL carrier or UL carrier is configured for a UE
  *   Case 2: 1 DL carrier and N UL carriers (N>1), where at least 1 UL carrier is frequency separated from the DL carrier, and no other DL carrier is configured for a UE
Cases 3 and 4 are just extensions with more DL carriers and/or more UL carriers configured, and case 5 is conventional CA.
Best regards,
David
